claim_boundary: This protocol can test transport of a method-selection and abstention policy to one untouched external study. It cannot establish universal method superiority, clinical utility, or biological validity.

registration_gate.unlock_rule: Both the protocol commit and a public GitHub issue containing its commit SHA and SHA-256 must be independently visible before any HER2ST count matrix, spot-level annotation, image, result table, or derived outcome is downloaded or opened.

external_study.name: HER2ST
external_study.ground_truth: pathologist-authored spot-region labels distributed by the source study
metadata_only_checks_before_lock: study title, DOI, public repository, and section/donor counts
existence of count, spot-selection, image, and pathologist-label directories
no file listing below those outcome-bearing directories

independence_contract.allowed_prelock_knowledge: Bibliographic citation and repository-level metadata only.
independence_contract.known_prelock_contact: The HistoWeave manuscript cited the HER2ST paper in its bibliography, but the repository audit found no HER2ST data bundle or HER2ST benchmark result in the project.
prohibited_until_unlock: clone or archive download of almaan/her2st
opening count, label, image, or result files
inspecting any HER2ST clustering score or recommendation outcome
independence_contract.deviation_rule: Any evidence that HER2ST outcome-bearing data or method performance was accessed before public registration changes the confirmatory status to retrospective_contaminated; results must still be retained but cannot satisfy the independent-validation claim.

analysis_unit.donor_parser: For every included section identifier, donor_id is the leading uppercase Latin letter A through H. Any identifier that cannot be mapped uniquely causes that section to be excluded with reason; fewer than five evaluable donors returns evidence_required.
analysis_unit.section_inclusion: Include every source-study section with a count matrix, a spot-selection table, spatial coordinates, and a pathologist-label file.
section_exclusion: fewer than 100 genes with nonzero counts
coordinates missing for any retained spot
no one-to-one join between retained spots and pathologist labels
analysis_unit.aggregation: Compute ARI per section and seed, average seeds within section, then average sections within donor. Bootstrap and hypothesis tests resample donors only.

task_contract.ground_truth_access: sealed during fitting; loaded only by a separate scoring process after prediction files and their hashes are final

common_input_contract.spot_set: The intersection of source tissue spots with finite coordinates and pathologist labels, fixed once per section and reused for every method.
common_input_contract.gene_filter: genes expressed in at least 3 retained spots
common_input_contract.method_internal_preprocessing: official method preprocessing is allowed and logged; no method may receive a different spot set, labels, true K, or histology
common_input_contract.subsampling: none when n_spots <= 4000; otherwise sample exactly 4000 spots without replacement using seed 20260729, stratified only by a 10 by 10 coordinate grid and never by labels

non_oracle_k.failure_rule: If K estimation fails, the section is unavailable for every method and is not repaired with truth K.

fixed_method_panel.clustering: native SpaGCN clustering constrained to shared estimated K
full-covariance Gaussian mixture on learned embedding at shared estimated K
full-covariance Gaussian mixture on learned embedding at shared estimated K

fixed_method_panel.implementation: official Bioconductor BayesSpace; installed version and Bioconductor snapshot must be recorded before execution
fixed_method_panel.clustering: native spatialCluster at shared estimated K

fixed_method_panel.implementation: official Bioconductor Banksy; installed version and Bioconductor snapshot must be recorded before execution
fixed_method_panel.clustering: official clusterBanksy constrained to shared estimated K

backend_failure_policy.minimum_panel_for_primary_analysis: All nine methods must succeed for at least five donors after donor aggregation.
backend_failure_policy.partial_failure: A donor-method score is available only when at least half of that donor's eligible sections and at least one section succeed. The same availability mask is applied to every policy comparison.
backend_failure_policy.failed_primary_panel: If the minimum panel is not met, report coverage and failures, retain all outputs, and mark the confirmatory decision endpoint evidence_required.

development_evidence.source: HistoWeave development panels available before this registration
development_evidence.global_default: Highest donor-weighted mean ARI in admissible development evidence; ties resolve by fixed method-panel order.
development_evidence.normalization: z-score each feature using development evidence only

decision_policies.action: Use the locked development global default on every donor.
Use the top-1 method from the existing target-free three-nearest-neighbour weighted recommender on every donor, without the HistoWeave evidence gate.

decision_policies.source: Chen et al. 2025, iMeta, DOI 10.1002/imt2.70084, Supplementary Table S2
decision_policies.action: Use the first published recommended method for the ST, breast, biological-replicate scenario that appears in the fixed panel. If no fixed-panel method is recommended or the rule is ambiguous, fall back to always_global and record zero personalisation coverage.
decision_policies.tie_break: published table order, then fixed method-panel order

decision_policies.action: Start with existing_knn_top1; personalise only when every locked evidence gate passes, otherwise use always_global.

histoweave_gate.heldout_validation_rule: Upper 95 percent donor-bootstrap confidence bound of mean(candidate regret minus global regret) is at most 0.02 on admissible development evidence.
histoweave_gate.abstention_semantics: At the decision-protocol level, abstention from personalisation means deployment of the global default. If no task-valid global evidence exists, return evidence_required instead of selecting a method.

risk_coverage_endpoints.unit_regret: best available fixed-panel ARI for that donor minus policy-selected method ARI
risk_coverage_endpoints.coverage: fraction of evaluable donors on which a policy selects a method different from always_global
risk_coverage_endpoints.selective_risk: mean regret among covered donors; undefined and reported as NA at zero coverage
risk_coverage_endpoints.deployed_risk: mean regret across all donors after global fallback on uncovered donors
risk_coverage_endpoints.primary_contrast: histoweave_gated minus always_global in deployed donor-level regret at threshold 0.25
risk_coverage_endpoints.primary_noninferiority: upper 95 percent donor-bootstrap confidence bound of the mean paired regret difference is at most 0.02
risk_coverage_endpoints.superiority: upper 95 percent donor-bootstrap confidence bound of the mean paired regret difference is below 0
risk_coverage_increment: coverage gain at deployed risk no greater than always_global risk plus 0.02
deployed-risk difference versus existing_knn_top1 at matched or higher coverage
deployed-risk difference versus published_srtbenchmark_2025 at matched or higher coverage
area under the deployed risk-coverage curve using trapezoidal integration over the locked grid
risk_coverage_endpoints.multiple_testing: Only the primary contrast is confirmatory. All other policy and threshold contrasts are descriptive with percentile intervals and no multiplicity-adjusted claim.

positive_control.purpose: Demonstrate that the implementation can personalise when a reliable target-free signal exists; this is not evidence of biological personalisation.
positive_control.independent_feature: x_signal sampled Uniform(-1, 1); all other target-free features are standard normal noise

conditional_performance.x_signal_below_zero: spectral mean ARI 0.78, stagate mean ARI 0.48
conditional_performance.x_signal_at_least_zero: stagate mean ARI 0.78, spectral mean ARI 0.48

positive_control.split: training and test units are generated independently; no test outcome enters fitting or threshold selection
success_conditions: histoweave_gated coverage is at least 0.50 on the 60 test units
at least spectral and stagate are selected on covered test units
upper 95 percent bootstrap confidence bound of mean(histoweave_gated regret minus always_global regret) is below 0
positive_control.failure_interpretation: Failure is an implementation or gate-calibration failure and must be retained; parameters may not be changed in the confirmatory run.

required_outputs: source_manifest.json with hashes and access timestamps
